'''Ace Azzameen's girlfriend''' was a female that once dated [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] prior to his joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. When she heard that he joined, she expressed her disgust to Ace's sister [[Aeron Azzameen|Aeron]], ending their relationship.
